text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While Ines Fujin's coworkers aren't especially familiar with the world of racing, they're still surprised to hear that she plans to compete in the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But they've seen Ines Fujin working hard first-hand, and this is her dream. Knowing full well how much effort she puts in, they root for her with all they have.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Mejiro Ryan—the hope of her prestigious family—finds herself the subject of great expectations. It sounds like she's being touted as the favorite to win the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While greatness is expected from both, Mejiro Ryan has conflicting feelings when she sees just how focused Ines Fujin is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Apparently, Mejiro Ryan plans to come and observe the Asahi Hai F.S. Excited to learn that her friend will be in attendance, Ines Fujin feels massively motivated.
